description.p: Tylia is a desktop Git client with a clear commit graph, staging down to single lines, and no clutter. It uses the Git you already have, so hooks, credential helpers, signing and your Git configuration work exactly as on the command line.

ul.li: History with a commit graph that stays fast on very large repositories
Stage, unstage and discard files, hunks or single lines
Fetch, pull and push with sign-in dialogs for HTTPS and SSH
Branches, merge, rebase, cherry-pick and revert, with per-block conflict resolution
Interactive rebase, blame, file history and git-flow helpers
A command palette and rebindable keyboard shortcuts

description.p: Tylia collects no telemetry and makes no network requests you did not ask for.

screenshot.caption: History: the commit graph, a commit's details and its diff
Changes: staged and unstaged files, a diff and the commit message

description.p: The first public release: the commit graph, staging down to single lines, fetch, pull and push with sign-in dialogs, branching with per-block conflict resolution, interactive rebase, blame, file history, git-flow helpers and a command palette.
